test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that correctly describes the use of the word ‘walking’ in the following sentence.

Walking is good for health.

options.text: Walking is the present participle form of the verb functioning as a gerund.
Walking is the past participle form of the verb.
Walking is the present tense form of the verb.
Walking is the base form of the verb.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"walking"** means the activity of going for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise. (टहलना)

 
 
• **Example:** **Walking** in the park every morning is refreshing.
 
 
 
• **"Gerund"** refers to a verb form that functions as a noun in a sentence. (संज्ञा रूप में क्रिया)
 
 
• **Example: Swimming__ is a good form of exercise.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is ***'__Walking__ is the present participle form of the verb functioning as a gerund.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** Walking is the past participle form of the verb. (गलत विकल्प)

 
 
• **Example:** The word "walked" is the past participle form of the verb "walk".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Walking is the present tense form of the verb. (गलत विकल्प)
 
 
• **Example:** The word "walk" is the present tense form of the verb.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Walking is the base form of the verb. (गलत विकल्प)
 
 
• **Example:** The word "walk" is the base form of the verb.
 
 

36:Tcde,

The correct answer is **Option 4)**
